q: How does MySQL 8.4 LTS full-text search integrate with Filament 4 table search?
a: In Filament 4 tables, global search and column search can be overridden to utilize native MySQL MATCH(...) AGAINST(? IN BOOLEAN MODE) queries via an Eloquent scope, avoiding slow LIKE '%...%' table scans on large tables.

q: Why is MySQL 8.4 LTS InnoDB chosen over PostgreSQL for this blueprint?
a: MySQL 8.4 LTS is the industry standard for traditional enterprise stacks and legacy migration targets, featuring refined InnoDB performance, histogram statistics, generated columns, and instant DDL operations.

q: How does the kit handle MySQL transaction deadlocks in Filament bulk actions?
a: The starter includes Laravel DB::transaction() wrappers configured with automatic deadlock retries (up to 3 attempts) and explicit lockForUpdate() row locking on customer records during batch mutations.

q: What collation and character set are configured for MySQL 8.4?
a: The database uses utf8mb4 character set with utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci collation, providing full Unicode 15 support, emoji handling, and accent-insensitive sorting.

q: How is Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) prevented in Filament resources?
a: Every Filament resource binds to an explicit Laravel Policy class. Filament automatically queries ModelPolicy::viewAny(), view(), and update() before rendering forms, ensuring users cannot access records outside their tenant scope.

q: Can generated virtual columns be indexed in MySQL 8.4 with Filament?
a: Yes. MySQL 8.4 allows indexing generated virtual or stored columns (e.g. JSON extraction expressions or concatenated full names), allowing Filament table filters to execute with zero runtime parsing overhead.

q: How does rootless containerization work with PHP 8.3 and MySQL 8.4?
a: The Dockerfile defines a dedicated appuser with UID 10001:10001. All process execution, Composer commands, and storage directory ownership belong to this non-root user, eliminating root escalation vulnerabilities.

q: How does Filament 4 support multi-tenancy in this MySQL kit?
a: Filament provides first-class tenancy configuration in AdminPanelProvider via tenant(Team::class), automatically scoping Eloquent queries to the active tenant ID in session.

q: What is the token consumption benchmark tier for this kit?
a: The kit is benchmarked at Tier A (16,100 median build tokens) due to Filament declarative table/form schemas and concise Eloquent relationships.

q: How does the starter authenticate admin users?
a: Authentication utilizes Laravel Fortify with Argon2id password hashing, session fixation protection, and optional FIDO2 WebAuthn / Passkeys authentication.

q: Are MySQL 8.4 strict SQL modes enforced?
a: Yes. STRICT_TRANS_TABLES, NO_ZERO_IN_DATE, NO_ZERO_DATE, and ERROR_FOR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO are explicitly enabled in config/database.php to prevent silent data truncation.

q: How do Pest architectural tests verify codebase hygiene?
a: Pest ArchTest asserts that all controllers remain lean, models extend Eloquent, no raw dd() or dump() calls exist in production code, and all resources define policies.

q: How does the Redis service integrate with Filament in this kit?
a: Redis 7.2 serves as the default cache store, queue driver, and session driver, supporting atomic locks and tag-based cache invalidation when Filament tables mutate.

q: What automated security scans run in CI for this kit?
a: GitHub Actions executes Gitleaks for secret detection, Semgrep with OWASP Top 10 rules, and manifest schema validation before any production deployment.
